title: Native 10-minute phase harness crates/apricity-link/tests/drift.rs with a JSON report
description:
## Intent
The native 10-minute phase harness. Makes apricitus-d0cfc3 and apricitus-dcb2ca green.

## Steps
1. `features/link/phase.feature` with the Gherkin of the M4 stories.
2. `crates/apricity-link/tests/drift.rs`, `#[ignore]`: two real Link peers in one process (M0 confirmed they discover each other over loopback): a scripted reference peer, and Apricity playing the M1 click score with the silent clock (virtual device time mapped to the Link clock as `play` does).
3. Click finder (from M1's test support) over Apricity's output; each onset's host time converted to the reference peer's beat; error = distance to the nearest whole beat.
4. JSON report at `renders/link-drift-native.json` (`renders/` is ignored by git): max, p99, per-click errors, re-warps and their bars, first failure.
5. Hard bounds: the run stops by itself at 11 minutes; every loop that waits on the engine has an iteration cap.

## Verify
`export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-link --test drift -- --ignored --nocapture` (about 11 minutes, under the 20-minute cap). Paste the report's summary in a comment.

Commit: `test(<this task id>): native phase harness`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
